Want to checkout the game then do so here: https://gsght.com/c/fe2tol

Welcome to the murdathon / Murdolympics special livestream where your likes on the video force me to go on a pirate based rampage in game! But  what game are we playing today! Well its Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced the latest game from ubisoft that is a remake of one of the greatest pirate games of all time that lets you take on the life of Edward Kenway as he enjoys the golden age of piracy! I played the original only a few years ago so when the offer of a sponsorship for the new one came along well who was I to deny the opportunity to sail the high seas and pillage spanish treasure fleets!  

Now the the rules for this stream are rather simple! Likes on the stream = Kills IN GAME! So we will be making various like targets for the stream that if met will keep our pirate rampage going!
